summary.zh: 搭建带缓存与多阶段作业的 GitLab CI
summary.en: Build GitLab CI pipelines with caching and stages

description.zh: 介绍多阶段作业、依赖缓存与分布式 runner 的组织方式，用于搭建自动化测试与部署流程。适合迁移到 GitLab 或压缩流水线耗时。需要可用的 GitLab Runner。
description.en: Covers multi-stage jobs, dependency caching and distributed runners for automated test and deploy flows. Suits moving to GitLab or trimming pipeline time. Requires available GitLab runners.
